The '''E-18 Blaster rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and the successor of the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]]. It was utilized by the [[Imperial Elite Guard]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] and ''[[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]]'' security service aboard ''[[Ormni]]''.
